name: Locomotive Half Marathon 2026
short_description: A half marathon in Bandar Lampung, Indonesia, held on September 20, 2026, with 21.1 km, 10 km, and 5 km distance options.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this event?
faqs.answer: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 offers three distance categories for participants to choose from: a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km race, and a shorter 5 km race, allowing runners of varying experience and fitness levels to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: The event is organized by PT Kereta Api Indonesia (KAI), the national railway company, with on-the-ground execution handled by RAW Organizer, operating locally as Runaway Lampung, in Bandar Lampung, Lampung, Indonesia, on September 20, 2026.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Interested runners can sign up ahead of the race date of September 20, 2026, though the exact start location within Bandar Lampung has not yet been officially announced by organizers.

faqs.question: Where and when will the race take place?
faqs.answer: The Locomotive Half Marathon 2026 will take place in Bandar Lampung, in the Lampung province of Indonesia, on September 20, 2026. While the city hosting the event is confirmed, the precise start point within Bandar Lampung has not yet been announced.
